progression_balancing.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

accessibility.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

local_items.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

non_local_items.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

start_inventory.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

start_hints.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

start_location_hints.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

exclude_locations.description: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

priority_locations.description: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

item_links.description: Share part of your item pool with other players.

death_link.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

enable_death_fragments.description:
If Death Link is enabled, turning this setting on gives you a Curse Card whenever
you receive a Death Link.

death_link_damage_percent.description:
If Death Link is enabled, this setting determines how much damage you take when you receive a Death Link, 
as a percentage of your max health. 
If you do not want to take any damage, set this to 0. 
If you want to be killed whenever you receive a Death Link, set this to 100.

characters.description:
Enter the list of characters to play as.  Valid characters are:
'Ironclad'
'Silent'
'Defect'
'Regent'
'Necrobinder'

modded_characters.description:
Enter the list of modded characters to play as.  These must be the internal names of the
characters.  This option is ignored if use_advanced_characters is set to true.  Only 5
modded characters are allowed.

If using a modded character:
Enter the internal ID of the character to use.

If you don't know the exact ID to enter with the mod installed go to
`Archipelago Settings -> Archipelago` to view a list of installed modded character IDs.

If the chosen character mod is not installed, checks will be sent when another character
sends them.  If none of the chosen character mods are installed, you will be playing
a very boring Ironclad run.

pick_num_characters.description:
Randomly select from the configured characters this many characters to generate for.
0 disables.
For example, if "character" is configured to be:
    character:
        - Ironclad
        - Silent
        - Defect
And pick_num_characters is set to 2, then one possible outcome is
to have a run with Ironclad and Defect, but not the Silent.

num_chars_goal.description: How many characters you need to complete a run with before you goal. 0 means all characters

lock_characters.description:
Whether in a multi character run "Unlock [Char]" items should be shuffled in.
locked_fixed means the unlocked_character option is used to determine which character to start with
locked_random means which character you start with is randomized
unlocked means you start with all characters available

unlocked_character.description:
Which character to start unlocked, if lock_characters is set to locked_fixed.
Can also enter a character name for modded characters.

use_advanced_characters.description:
Whether to use the advanced characters feature. The normal options for character, ascension, etc. are ignored.
See the "advanced_characters" option.

advanced_characters.description:
The configuration for advanced characters.  Each character's options can be configured
independently of each other.  No validation is done on the character name, so use carefully.
Format is:
    <char name>:
        ascension:
            - <string or number>
        ascension_down:
            - <string or number>

If using a modded character:
Enter the internal ID of the character to use.

If you don't know the exact ID to enter with the mod installed go to
`Archipelago Settings -> Archipelago` to view a list of installed modded character IDs.

If the chosen character mod is not installed, checks will be sent when another character
sends them.  If none of the chosen character mods are installed, you will be playing
a very boring Ironclad run.

ascension.description:
What Ascensions do you wish to play with. Note that logic is written assuming ascension 1
Valid values are the numbers for the ascensions, and the names for the ascensions.  When a number is provided
alone, all ascensions below that number will also be enabled.

The ascension names are as follows:
- 'SwarmingElites'
- 'WearyTraveler'
- 'Poverty'
- 'TightBelt'
- "AscenderBane"
- 'Inflation'
- 'Scarcity'
- 'ToughEnemies'
- 'DeadlyEnemies'
- 'DoubleBoss'

ascension_down.description:
The ascension downs to add to the item pool, per character. Only valid when
`use_advanced_characters` is false (see `advanced_characters`), and when `include_floor_checks` is true.
Valid values are the numbers for the ascensions, and also the names for the ascensions.  When a number is provided
alone, ascension downs for all the ones below will also be added to the pool.

- 'SwarmingElites'
- 'WearyTraveler'
- 'Poverty'
- 'TightBelt'
- "AscenderBane"
- 'Inflation'
- 'Scarcity'
- 'ToughEnemies'
- 'DeadlyEnemies'
- 'DoubleBoss'

Logic does NOT account for this.

shuffle_all_cards.description: Whether every card reward is shuffled.  If false, then every other card reward is shuffled

include_floor_checks.description: Whether to include reaching new floors as a location.  Adds small amounts of gold as items.

one_gold_filler_weight.description:
Weight for One Gold filler items. Generates one gold for the character who receives it.
Available across runs, as a pool of all gold rewards.

Note: Even if you disable this item, you may still see it in on rare occasion, 
as it's the fallback for when item generation has issues.

five_gold_filler_weight.description:
Weight for Five Gold filler items. Generates five gold for the character who receives it.
Available across runs, as a pool of all gold rewards.

free_attack_filler_weight.description: Weight for Free Attack filler items. Grants a buff that makes the next attack card you play free.

free_power_filler_weight.description: Weight for Free Power filler items. Grants a buff that makes the next power card you play free.

free_skill_filler_weight.description: Weight for Free Skill filler items. Grants a buff that makes the next skill card you play free.

vigor_filler_weight.description: Weight for Vigor filler items. Grants a buff that provides Vigor for the next combat.

artifact_filler_weight.description: Weight for Artifact filler items. Grants a buff that protects you from debuffs for the next combat.

thorns_filler_weight.description: Weight for Thorns filler items. Grants a buff that provides Thorns for the next combat.

buffer_filler_weight.description: Weight for Buffer filler items. Grants a buff that provides Buffer for the next combat.

dexterity_filler_weight.description: Weight for Dexterity filler items. Grants a buff that increases Dexterity for the next combat.

strength_filler_weight.description: Weight for Strength filler items. Grants a buff that increases Strength for the next combat.

plating_filler_weight.description: Weight for Plating filler items. Grants a buff that provides Plating for the next combat.

friendship_filler_weight.description: Weight for Friendship filler items. Raises the Max Energy per turn by 1 for the next combat.

post_combat_card_upgrade_filler_weight.description: Weight for Post-Combat Card Upgrade filler items. Grants a buff that randomly upgrades a card in your deck after combat.

post_combat_card_removal_filler_weight.description: Weight for Post-Combat Card Removal filler items. Grants a buff that lets you removes a card from your deck after combat.

additional_card_reward_filler_weight.description: Weight for Additional Card Reward filler items. Grants a buff that provides an additional card reward after combat.

neow_sanity.description: Whether to shuffle Neow giving you a start of run bonus or not.

campfire_sanity.description:
Whether to shuffle being able to rest and smith at each campsite per act.  Also adds
new locations at campsites per act.

gold_sanity.description: Whether to enable shuffling gold rewards into the multiworld. Adds 22 locations per character

potion_sanity.description: Whether to enable shuffling potion drops into the multiworld; adds 9 locations per character.

shop_sanity.description: Whether to shuffle shop slots into the pool.  Also adds new locations at the shop per slot shuffled.

shop_card_slots.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of colored card slots to shuffle.

shop_neutral_card_slots.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of neutral card slots to shuffle.

shop_relic_slots.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of relic slots to shuffle.

shop_potion_slots.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of potion slots to shuffle

shop_remove_slots.description:
When shop_sanity is enabled, whether to shuffle the ability to remove cards at the shop.
Progressive based on Act; i.e. you'll gain the ability to remove cards per Act, starting from Act 1.
Act 4 will be treated as Act 3.

shop_sanity_costs.description:
How expensive the AP shop items should be. Tiered means costs map to typical costs rarity for the slot.
Progression = Rare, Useful = Uncommon, Filler = Common
Logic does not take this option into account.
Fixed=15 gold each
Super_Discount_Tiered=20% of tiered costs
Discount_Tiered=50% of tiered costs
Tiered=Vanilla price for slot

seeded.description: Whether each character should have a fixed seed to climb the spire with or not.
